definitions.meaning: An explicit worktree-bound post-commit adapter with selected scopes, limits and source bindings.
Exact rendered hook bytes owned by this installer; modified or foreign bytes are preserved.

product_outcome: After a successful commit, refresh selected recent-context caches without changing commit outcome.
business_constraint: Preserve existing hooks and make local effects inspectable and removable.

model_binding.operation: existing observation-only model plus explicit CacheRefresh adapter

policies.installation: atomic exclusive creation; repeated same configuration is unchanged
policies.uninstall: exact owned bytes only; retain caches
policies.scope: one selected worktree; repository-local hook path only
policies.runtime: POSIX Python and Git; 30-second total refresh budget
policies.failure: stderr diagnostic; wrapper exits zero after completed commit
policies.sources: pin installer, Git adapter and project resolver; refuse refresh on drift

product_construction.frontier: installer implementation and real Git lifecycle tests
